summary: Backend-only UX Phase A testing completed against the public endpoint. Final suite: 15/16 passed (93.8%). Import Last Rx, outstanding balance aggregation, UPI verification, Razorpay/non-Razorpay gateway verification, unpaid/foreign receipt guards, cash overpayment protection, both supplied logins, and requested regressions passed. Paid send-receipt incorrectly reports and persists success when WhatsApp is unconfigured.

critical.issue: With Twilio/WhatsApp unconfigured, send_whatsapp_message returned None and logged that sending was skipped, but the endpoint returned receipt_sent:true and persisted receipt_status:'sent' plus a receipt_sent_at timestamp. Expected receipt_sent:false and failed/no timestamp. Reproduced in the full suite and two focused retries.

action_items: In send_invoice_receipt, derive sent from the return value of send_whatsapp_message (for example, sent = bool(await send_whatsapp_message(...))) instead of treating every non-throwing no-op as success; persist failed status and no sent timestamp when the result is falsy.
Use resolve_owner_id(current_user) in outstanding_balance so receptionist/front-desk/assistant users query the owning practice's invoices, consistent with invoice CRUD.
critical_code_review_comments: settings.send_invoice_receipt unconditionally assigns sent=True after awaiting send_whatsapp_message, while shared.send_whatsapp_message explicitly returns None both when Twilio is absent and when provider sending fails internally; this creates false delivery acknowledgements and inaccurate audit fields.

prescriptions.outstanding_balance uses current_user['id'] rather than resolve_owner_id(current_user), although invoice records are stored under resolved owner_id. Authenticated clinic sub-users will therefore receive a false zero balance for the owner's patients.
seed_data_creation: Created one isolated TEST doctor, one appointment/client, one prescription, and six invoices through public APIs per full run; focused retries created isolated paid invoices. Teardown removed all test users, settings, prescriptions, reminders, appointments, clients, invoices, counters, and test login-limit rows.
test_credentials: Used Doctor / Test Professional and Meta App Review Reviewer credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; no supplied passwords were embedded in the test file.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The deterministic failing case is TestInvoiceReceiptAndCashProtection::test_01_paid_invoice_receipt_noops_without_whatsapp_provider. Backend logs show 'Twilio not configured - WhatsApp send skipped' immediately before HTTP 200, while GET invoice shows receipt_status='sent' and a non-null receipt_sent_at. All other 15 cases pass, including the iteration_15 overpayment regression with persistence verification.
rca_of_the_issue: send_invoice_receipt ignores the sender's return value: it awaits send_whatsapp_message and then sets sent=True unless an exception escapes. The shared sender returns None instead of raising when Twilio is unconfigured or when its internal send catches an exception, so the endpoint misclassifies a skipped/failed dispatch as delivered and writes incorrect receipt audit state.
